items.q: How does the AI Coach work?
items.a: Our specialized AI agents automatically analyze every aspect of your game: economy, positioning, and mechanics. You receive personalized round-by-round feedback that you can query interactively.
Currently StratAI supports Counter-Strike 2. We analyze competitive and premier match demos with tactical precision built around CS2.

items.q: Is it safe to connect my Steam account?
items.a: Yes. We use Steam's official authentication system. We never have access to your password or credentials.

items.q: How long does demo analysis take?
items.a: The platform is designed to return analysis in seconds after processing a match, with optimized parsing and coaching feedback ready to review.

items.q: Can I use the platform for free?
items.a: Yes. The Free plan includes 5 demos per month, basic AI Coach access, interactive map, stats for the last 10 matches, and monthly challenges.
Each month, personalized challenges are generated based on your areas of improvement. Completing them unlocks achievements and moves you up in the global ranking.

items.q: What does the interactive map show?
items.a: The interactive map represents each CS2 map with data from your matches: positions of won and lost duels, grenade trajectories, movement heatmaps, and tactical insights by zone.
